title: Contract Breach Basics
text: A contract breach occurs when a party fails to perform an obligation stated in the agreement. Remedies may include damages or specific performance.

title: Tenant Rights Overview
text: Tenant rights often include quiet enjoyment, habitable premises, notice before eviction, and return of a security deposit subject to the lease and local law.

title: Employment Dispute Notes
text: Employment disputes may concern wages, discrimination, termination, workplace policies, and contractual duties.

title: Confidentiality Clause Guide
text: A confidentiality clause identifies information that must be protected and describes permitted disclosure, duration, and exceptions.

title: Court Appeal Procedure
text: An appeal asks a higher court to review a lower court decision under the applicable procedural rules and deadlines.
